val_replay_deviation.statement: MambaPlace's operators sample object points with T.FixedPoints(256) using PyG's default replace=True (np.random.choice on the global NumPy RNG) on every call, and training/coarse.py:23 + training/fine.py:24 seed NumPy from MP_SEED at import. A fresh process therefore replays the SAME draw deterministically, while the numbers logged during training come from the RNG state at that epoch, which was consumed by 20 (resp. 35) epochs of shuffling and augmentation and was never saved. Exact reproduction of the logged value is impossible by construction; the gate is agreement within the measured band.

export_draw.note: the exported VAL instantiation, reproduced bitwise by verify_val_mp.py in a separate process

strict_replay.reading: the strict 1e-3 check compares the fresh draw with the in-training draw; its MISMATCH verdict is the expected consequence of the seeding mechanism, not a checkpoint defect. The same script shows the export cache is reproduced with cell/text encoding max-abs difference 0.0 and identical accuracies, i.e. the frozen weights are deterministic given a fresh process.

val_replay_deviation.consequence: The exported VAL instantiation is used as-is. Every method shares this one export (identical candidates, Fine positions and encodings), so all comparisons are paired; no backbone retraining, no re-selection, no threshold tuning on VAL.
